source.publication: 2025 IT-511 Individual Income Tax Booklet (Georgia DOR), with Form 500 and Schedule 1 bound in (PDF pages 41-49)
source.section: Subtractions item 2 'Military Retirement Income' (PDF pp.21-22); Schedule 1 page 3 'Do I Qualify' box and lines 1-8 (PDF p.49; 2025GA500.pdf p.9): line 2 base military exclusion 17,500, line 3 lesser of lines 1 and 2, stop if Georgia earned income is less than 17,501; Form 500 lines 8-16 (booklet PDF pp.16-17: Line 8 federal AGI, Line 10 Georgia AGI, Line 11 standard deduction, Lines 13-15c, Line 16 'Multiply the amount on Line 15c by 5.19%. Round to nearest dollar.'); Form 500 Schedule 1 page 1 lines 1-14 (PDF p.47); rate cite PDF p.9 What's New; standard deduction cite PDF p.16 Line 11

worked: Federal AGI = military retirement 30,000.00 + interest 5,000.00 = 35,000.00. Federal taxable income = 35,000.00 - (standard deduction 15,750.00) = 19,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored; federal figures are given, not tested; Georgia starts from federal AGI). Schedule 1 page 3 (age 55, under 62, so qualifies): line 1 taxable military retirement 30,000.00; line 2 base 17,500.00; line 3 lesser = 17,500.00. Military retirement is 17,501 or more, so continue: line 4 Georgia salary and wages 0.00; line 5 other earned Georgia income 0.00; line 6 total Georgia earned income 0.00, less than 17,501, so stop: line 7b = 17,500.00 (no additional exclusion; the additional 17,500 is not modelled in the projection, and does not apply here). The interest is taxed: no retirement income exclusion under 62. Schedule 1 additions lines 1-5 none, line 6 = 0.00. Schedule 1 line 13 total subtractions = line 7b military retirement income exclusion 17,500.00 = 17,500.00; line 14 net adjustments = 0.00 - 17,500.00 = -17,500.00. Form 500 line 8 federal AGI 35,000.00; line 9 = -17,500.00; line 10 Georgia AGI = 35,000.00 - 17,500.00 = 17,500.00. Line 11 standard deduction (single) 12,000.00 (the filer takes the federal standard deduction, so must take Georgia's); line 13 = 17,500.00 - 12,000.00 = 5,500.00; line 14 dependent exemption 0 dependents = 0.00; line 15a = 5,500.00; line 15b NOL 0.00; line 15c = 5,500.00. Line 16 tax = 5.19% x 5,500.00 = 285.4500 = 285.45; the form rounds to the nearest dollar and gives 285; expected uses the unrounded formula to the cent. Line 17 Low Income Credit: federal AGI is not under 20,000, so none; no other credits; credits 0.00; state income tax = 285.45.
